values.binNote: The bin only exposes UltMult=2, a flat multiplier applied to NamiPassive#TotalMSBonus (base 100, ap coef 0.25). 2x100=200 matches the wiki's flat value, but 2x0.25=0.5 for the AP ratio is not a separate data row - it is my derivation from UltMult times TotalMSBonus's ap coefficient, not a value directly named in the sheet.

mechanics.claim: Nami's abilities grant bonus movement speed to allied champions hit by them.
mechanics.quote: '''Nami's''' {{tip|abilities}} grant {{sti|ms|{{as|100|ms}}}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} to allied {{tip|champions}} hit

mechanics.claim: Tidal Wave uses a separate, higher-priority empowered buff instead of stacking with the normal buff.
mechanics.quote: ''Tidal Wave'' uses a separate empowered buff that has priority over the normal buff, and it will be used even if the full/current strength of the empowered buff is weaker than the full-strength normal buff.

mechanics.claim: If the normal buff is still active when the empowered buff expires, it restarts at full strength and decays over its remaining duration.
mechanics.quote: If the normal buff remains ongoing when the empowered buff expires, it will then begin with full strength and completely decay over its '''remaining''' duration.
